description.en-US: The 1948 abridged English translation of The Admirable Heart of Mary by Charles di Targiani and Ruth Hauser, in ten parts.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa resumida de 1948 de O Coração admirável de Maria, em dez partes.

en-US.translator: Charles di Targiani and Ruth Hauser

sources.edition: The Admirable Heart of Mary, translated by Charles di Targiani and Ruth Hauser, New York, P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1948. Text layer of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère PDF (liberius.net), from the Eudist Fathers series, 1946–48.
sources.description: Converted by script: running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs rejoined, hyphenation repaired. The OCR of the PDF text layer leaves some residual errors (for example 0 for O, rn for m); the translator’s introduction and notes are kept. The translation is not aligned chapter by chapter to the French edition, so it is a separate book.
sources.tierEvidence: Copyright 1946–48 P. J. Kenedy & Sons; no renewal in the Copyright Office records 1950–2001.
